create_package_exporter: create a torch.package PackageExporter to export PyTorch model code and data into a self-contained zip archive
build_package_intern_modules: build a torch.package export that interns user-defined modules by scanning source for dependencies
build_package_mock_dependencies: build a torch.package export that mocks external dependencies like torch to avoid bundling them
build_package_extern_stdlib: build a torch.package export that externs standard library and torch modules to load from the host environment
save_pickle_torch_object: save a picklable Python object into a torch.package archive with automatic dependency resolution
